title: Saturn OBD/OBD2 Codes >> Aura – ION – Outlook – Relay – Sky – VUE (2002 – 2009)

procedures.heading: General information
steps: Malfunction indicator lamp (MIL) will illuminate or flash if certain faults are recorded.
ECM operates in backup mode if sensors fail, to enable vehicle to be driven to repair shop.
